name: Viridis Canon (Lean 4 + Mathlib)
postCreateCommand: curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover/elan/master/elan-init.sh | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain none && ~/.elan/bin/lake exe cache get && python3 certificates/verify_bundle.py
